## I was charged for an automatic…
I was charged for an automatic subscription renewal that I did not intend to continue. What makes the experience even more frustrating is that there is no clearly stated practice of sending advance notifications or reminders before renewal.  
  
I contacted customer support immediately, requesting cancellation and a refund. More than 48 hours have passed, and then received charge isn’t eligible for a refund.  
  
I understand that subscriptions may renew automatically, but customers should be given proper notice and, most importantly, receive timely support when they contact the company about unexpected charges. [...] ### What people talk about most

I tried DaVinci AI with a $1.99 trial and used the service for one incident (not even a full day) and found that it was terrible. It completely failed to function as advertised or follow basic instructions. Despite my explicit prompts with exact spelling instructions IN QUOTES, the AI produced content with incorrect spelling, gibberish, and words in entirely wrong languages, making the output completely unusable. I wasn't able to use the content as it was wrong so I abandoned it.
